controls.name: placement
controls.description: Viewport placement of the modal surface.

controls.name: edge
controls.description: Inset adds the system viewport gap, radius, and border; flush attaches the surface to its placement edge.

controls.name: width
controls.description: Preferred surface width in pixels, constrained by the viewport.

controls.name: height
controls.description: Preferred surface height in pixels, constrained by the viewport.

controls.name: closeOnOverlayClick
controls.description: Close the surface when its backdrop is clicked.

controls.name: closable
controls.description: Whether the surface can be closed via Escape / backdrop click.

controls.name: title
controls.description: Title content rendered inside the surface.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Description content rendered below the title.

controls.name: trigger
controls.description: Trigger element that toggles the modal open.

controls.name: autoFocusOnOpen
controls.description: Move focus into the surface when it opens. Disable for bounded previews that render it inline.

controls.name: scrollLock
controls.description: Lock body scroll while the modal is open. Opt-in; off by default.

controls.name: portal
controls.description: Render overlay into document.body. Disable for bounded component previews.
